trigger_3_all_three_strictly_worse_under.rationale: In S1, Variance under B is strictly lower than under A (133.476 < 136.130). If S2 reproduces Variance within the 1.0% cross-environment tolerance, Trigger 3 is guaranteed to be false prior to run. It remains implemented in code for exhaustive protocol fidelity, but carries no independent confirmatory weight.
